sources.title: Holographic conformal order in supergravity

evidence.text: The shared setting tests scalar condensates in M2-brane holography through two consistent truncations of four-dimensional gauged supergravity. A real scalar and planar metric describe the candidate ordered thermal states.

sources.title: The phase diagram of confining holographic theories on constant curvature manifolds in the presence of a θ-angle

evidence.text: How do dimensionless curvature and the θ-angle determine acceptable ground-state saddles and phase transitions of confining holographic QFTs, and can the axial sector supply a boundary order parameter?

sources.title: Witten-Veneziano from Green-Schwarz

evidence.text: Can the Witten–Veneziano relation for the η′ mass be obtained holographically by identifying the closed-string mode responsible for generalized Green–Schwarz cancellation of the axial anomaly with the η′?

sources.title: Holographic conformal order in supergravity

evidence.text: Insert a scalar potential into the radial system and impose regular horizon data and a source-free boundary condition. The source reports the reduction; the analytical checks below verify vacuum normalization and leading scalar limits without certifying every nonlinear metric term.

sources.title: The phase diagram of confining holographic theories on constant curvature manifolds in the presence of a θ-angle

evidence.text: UV/IR asymptotic expansions classify endpoints and provide boundary conditions for numerical flows. Generalized dimensional reduction identifies the axion with an internal n-form and motivates γ=1/b for shrinking spherical compactifications.

sources.title: Witten-Veneziano from Green-Schwarz

evidence.text: For a generic confining metric ds²=dr²+f(r)dxμ², separate the bulk wave equation using K=e^{iqx}F(r). Interpret the radial spectrum as four-dimensional hadron masses and write boundary propagators with poles 1/(q²−M²).

sources.title: Holographic conformal order in supergravity

evidence.text: A nonlinear scalar seed sources linear metric corrections, and the perturbative solution seeds a full finite-b boundary-value problem. Following the branch toward smaller b gives observable curves and extrapolated critical values.

sources.title: Holographic conformal order in supergravity

evidence.text: Deform the interactions, solve a nonlinear leading scalar problem on the hairless geometry, and compute sourced metric corrections. The construction produces a large-b seed; continuation to b=1 is a separate numerical operation.

sources.title: Holographic conformal order in supergravity

evidence.text: Solve the two-endpoint problem for a nonzero profile. This establishes the required seed directly rather than inferring its existence from a local effective-mass argument.

sources.title: Non-equilibrium dynamics in Holography

evidence.text: Do the field-theory and holographic calculations agree when branches, dictionaries, and counterterm schemes describe the same deformed sphere theory?

sources.title: Weak Gravity Conjecture, Central Charges and $\eta/s$

evidence.text: Does an assumed AdS weak gravity conjecture constrain higher-derivative couplings sufficiently to enforce the KSS bound at extremality, and how do these constraints interact with holographic central-charge bounds?

sources.title: Confinement in de Sitter space and the swampland

evidence.text: What does the conjectural confinement bound Λc ≳ H imply for holographic theories in de Sitter space, with scalar stabilization and finite-lived extrema?

destination.title: Holographic descriptions, observables and consistency
destination.question: How do holographic descriptions encode gravitational physics, calculate observables and test consistency across different systems and regimes?
destination.summary: Usable as a broad navigation proposal. No original verbal region scope was supplied, so its numerical membership cannot certify an exact scientific boundary. Consistency constraints form one narrower direction alongside foundational, computational and application questions.

systems: Localized-species, brane, wedge and coupled-sector descriptions
Proposed de Sitter dualities and cosmological geometries
Holographic models of field-theory observables and phases
targets: Existence and interpretation of holographic descriptions
Bulk geometry, topology, information and horizons
Complexity, brane gravity and vacuum dynamics
regimes: Classical, semiclassical, perturbative and finite-quantum-coupling regimes where individually specified
Different spacetime dimensions, boundary conditions and asymptotics
assumptions: Large N, factorization, weak curvature, gravity decoupling and conjectured bounds are source-local conditions
Numerical membership and sampling roles do not establish scientific inclusion or exclusion
conventions: Action and volume complexity remain distinct proposals
Different meanings of factorization remain distinguishable
Source settings, methods and claims retain their extracted object types
includes: Applications with useful homes outside the consistency-test direction
Conditional, historical and challenged proposals with their qualifications
excludes: A common AdS, Einstein-gravity, large-N or string-embedding premise
Automatic equivalence of questions sharing an overview card

sources.title: Strong Coupling Holography

evidence.text: Does the bulk holographic scale for N species constrain the strong-coupling scale of their four-dimensional brane theory, including limits that decouple gravity and examples without an AdS near-horizon geometry?

sources.title: Micromanaging de Sitter holography

evidence.text: Can uplifting Freund-Rubin AdS/CFT constructions provide microscopic realizations of metastable de Sitter holography and account for the parametric scaling of Gibbons-Hawking entropy?

sources.title: Non-relativistic holography from Horava gravity

evidence.text: What bulk gravitational field content and gauge symmetries can holographically represent generic nonrelativistic QFTs with conserved particle number, and can the resulting dictionary reproduce the correlation-function structure required by nonrelativistic conformal symmetry?

sources.title: Holography of Species in Cascading DGP

evidence.text: Can species holography determine crossover scales, Planck hierarchies and Vainshtein scales in Cascading DGP, including a gravitational interpretation that survives gravity decoupling?

sources.title: Holographic complexity and spacetime singularities

evidence.text: How does the proposed extremal-volume measure of holographic complexity evolve toward cosmological crunch singularities, when the boundary Hamiltonian reaches the singularity in finite time?

sources.title: AdS Vacuum Bubbles, Holography and Dual RG Flows

evidence.text: Can semiclassical vacuum-bubble nucleation and expansion in AdS3 be interpreted holographically as a relevant deformation followed by an RG flow, with entanglement entropy providing evidence through candidate c-functions?

sources.title: Complexity growth and shock wave geometry in AdS-Maxwell-power-Yang–Mills theory

evidence.text: How do a non-Abelian Yang–Mills charge and its power γ affect late-time holographic complexity growth, the stated Lloyd-bound test, and perturbation spreading in a local shock-wave geometry?

sources.title: De Sitter and Anti-de Sitter branes in self-tuning models

evidence.text: Can the holographic self-tuning framework admit stabilized de Sitter or anti-de Sitter branes, and which boundary sources are required?

sources.title: Curing with Hemlock: Escaping the swampland using instabilities from string theory

evidence.text: How can the dark-bubble bulk be regulated for a holographic interpretation while satisfying bulk and brane Einstein equations? The essay proposes a reflection-symmetric RS-brane with two interior AdS regions.

sources.title: Holography, Supergravity, and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: How can subleading holographic anomalies be extracted from superconformal indices, which fields admit consistent truncation on the Lunin–Maldacena background, and what gauge-gravity EFT constraints follow from corrected black-hole extremality and entropy?

sources.title: Disorder averaging and its UV discontents

evidence.text: When can multiple holographic QFT sectors be interpreted through one effective AdS geometry?

sources.title: Effective action, spectrum and first law of wedge holography

evidence.text: What effective brane action, vector/graviton spectrum, Weyl anomaly and entanglement first law arise in wedge holography beyond its previously studied special solutions?

sources.title: Factorization and global symmetries in holography

evidence.text: Can removing bulk one-form global symmetries turn Chern-Simons models of ensemble holography into topology-independent theories dual to individual CFTs, with factorized wormhole amplitudes?

sources.title: Confinement in de Sitter space and the swampland

evidence.text: What does the conjectural confinement bound Λc ≳ H imply for holographic theories in de Sitter space, with scalar stabilization and finite-lived extrema?

sources.title: Restricted quantum focusing

evidence.text: Can a weaker focusing condition imposed only where quantum expansion vanishes retain the essential applications of the full quantum focusing conjecture, and can that condition be proved in holographic brane-world semiclassical gravity?

sources.title: Yang-Baxter deformed wedge holography

evidence.text: How does homogeneous Yang–Baxter deformation affect wedge holography, Karch–Randall brane tensions, island/Page-curve calculations and late-time holographic complexity?

sources.title: End of the world perspective to BCFT

evidence.text: How can tension-dependent BCFT2 thermodynamics be combined with the effective JT thermodynamics seen by EOW-brane observers, and what do these observers see when temperature is lowered and the branes meet?

sources.title: Holographic complexity: braneworld gravity versus the Lloyd bound

evidence.text: How does brane-localized JT gravity alter volume-complexity growth in planar BTZ, which couplings respect the Lloyd bound, and can bulk energy conditions explain violations?

sources.title: Communicating multiverses in a holographic de Sitter braneworld

evidence.text: Can wedge holography be constructed with a de Sitter bulk and de Sitter gravitating branes, and can suitable arrangements and gluing of those branes model universes or multiverses capable of exchanging information?

sources.title: Explorations in Precision Holography and Higher-derivative Supergravity

evidence.text: What controlled subleading holographic information follows from higher-derivative supergravity, and do holographic c-function monotonicity and consistent truncations survive four-derivative corrections?

sources.title: String compactification, effective field theory and holography swampland

evidence.text: What holographic spectra and anomalous-dimension signs arise from fibred LVS and M-theory moduli stabilization, and how do charged-black-hole Wheeler–DeWitt states connect interiors, boundary partition functions and horizon thermodynamics?

sources.title: Holography and Riemann surfaces

evidence.text: How does semiclassical AdS3 holography extend to compact Riemann-surface boundaries of arbitrary genus, and what do the resulting gravitational actions imply for boundary stress tensors, black-hole topology and thermodynamics?

sources.title: Holographic domains of anti-de Sitter space

evidence.text: Which bulk region can be holographically encoded on an AdS4 brane with localized gravity, despite the infinite AdS5 volume, and how does a bulk particle's brane image disappear when it leaves that region?

sources.title: Constant curvature black hole and dual field theory

evidence.text: Can a five-dimensional constant curvature black hole support a holographic stress-tensor calculation on its time-dependent boundary, and how does this geometry relate to Schwarzschild–AdS bubbles of nothing?

sources.title: Wormholes in AdS

evidence.text: Can Euclidean AdS geometries connect disconnected boundaries supporting well-defined field theories, and how should their correlations and continued closed cosmologies be interpreted holographically?

sources.title: Non-equilibrium dynamics in Holography

evidence.text: Which complex-frequency modes describe linear response of a strongly coupled field theory through its gravitational dual?

sources.title: Strong Coupling Holography

evidence.text: KK spectral decomposition describes the effective brane graviton. Power counting of the scalar-helicity trilinear interaction determines nonlinear radii; BPS deficit-angle counting and D3 geometric scale relations provide additional examples.

sources.title: Micromanaging de Sitter holography

evidence.text: Analyze retained-modulus Hessians, orientifold projections and anisotropic deformations. Estimate brane-antibrane stability using discrete Wilson lines and T-duality. Assess localization corrections through warp-factor and p-form equations, distinguishing their pointwise role from their contribution to the averaged potential.

sources.title: Non-relativistic holography from Horava gravity

evidence.text: Derive nonrelativistic source transformations through a c→∞ limit with chemical potential tuned to cancel particle rest energy. Construct the bulk dictionary through both a shrinking-circle Kaluza–Klein scaling limit and a direct Einstein–Maxwell nonrelativistic limit.

sources.title: Holography of Species in Cascading DGP

evidence.text: Reviews an information-storage argument: localizing N distinguishable species in a box costs energy N/Lbox; requiring the box to exceed its gravitational radius gives the species resolution bound.

sources.title: Holographic complexity and spacetime singularities

evidence.text: Apply the imported proposal C(t)∝Vol(Σt)/(Gℓ), with Σt a spacelike codimension-one extremal, maximal-volume surface anchored at boundary time t. The estimates primarily concern bare complexity with a time-independent UV cutoff in the selected boundary frame.

sources.title: AdS Vacuum Bubbles, Holography and Dual RG Flows

evidence.text: Use holographic integral geometry: ω=∂u∂vℒ du∧dv=4G3∂u∂vSent du∧dv. Its ratio Ω to the original vacuum kinematic-space volume form is finite and scalar, permitting SO(1,2) transformations of centered-bubble data.

sources.title: Large N field theories, string theory and gravity

evidence.text: What motivates the holographic correspondence between large-N field theories and string/M theory on AdS backgrounds, what evidence tests it, and what can classical or semiclassical gravity calculate about strongly coupled field theories?

sources.title: Mixed gauge-global symmetries, elliptic modes, and black hole thermodynamics in Hořava-Lifshitz gravity

evidence.text: Does the charge associated with foliation-label reparameterization explain the failed first law for misaligned asymptotically AdS universal horizons, and how might the same structure affect holographic arguments requiring local gauge symmetries?

sources.title: The double cone geometry is stable to brane nucleation

evidence.text: Does semiclassical brane nucleation destabilize the complex double cone proposed to account for the spectral form factor ramp in higher-dimensional holography?

sources.title: Non-equilibrium dynamics in Holography

evidence.text: Holography replaces selected strongly coupled field-theory questions with gravitational ones. Its classical use invokes large N, strong coupling and weak bulk curvature; these conditions delimit the calculational laboratory discussed in the window.

sources.title: Quantum gravity on the bulk cone

evidence.text: Can classical bulk-cone singularities from returning bulk null geodesics persist in exact finite-GN holographic correlators, and can their resolution be explained by quantum fluctuations of geometry?

sources.title: Holographic Constraints on the String Landscape

evidence.text: Can holographic consistency at spacetime boundaries constrain scalar potentials in the interior of moduli space, establish special cases of TCC and the Strong AdS Distance Conjecture, and diagnose proposed landscape vacua?

sources.title: Are tiny gauge couplings out of the Swampland?

evidence.text: Which holographic families admit a bulk expansion controlled by Newton's constant? The assumed CFT spectrum and factorization properties select an Einstein regime with finitely many light fields and C_T growing as N^2.

sources.title: Baby universes in string theory

evidence.text: What do the O(e^−N) corrections that spoil large-N holomorphic factorization of two-dimensional Yang–Mills mean in the dual black-hole geometry, and can their baby-universe interpretation preserve quantum coherence?

sources.title: Quantum Gates to other Universes

evidence.text: Can two large holographic AdS4 universes be connected by a microscopic, local, quantized weak link, and what small graviton mass does that link generate?

sources.title: Holography vs. Scale Separation

evidence.text: Can parametrically scale-separated AdS admit a holographic CFT obtained by decoupling a string-theory brane, and what asymptotic scalar-potential condition does this require?

sources.title: A compendium of logarithmic corrections in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: How do four-dimensional bulk one-loop effects reproduce logarithmic terms in holographic CFT partition functions and black-hole entropy, and what conditional constraints follow for AdS4 matter spectra and scale separation?

sources.title: Cryptographic Censorship

evidence.text: Can computational restrictions on learning holographic CFT dynamics guarantee bulk event horizons without assuming global hyperbolicity, and help formulate quantum weak cosmic censorship that permits sufficiently small naked singularities?

sources.title: Holographic consistency and the sign of the Gauss-Bonnet parameter

evidence.text: Can the simplest Einstein–Gauss–Bonnet theory with α<0 supply consistent AdS holographic geometries, or does a geometric probe-brane consistency condition support excluding this sign from the effective theory?

sources.title: De Sitter Space and the Swampland

evidence.text: How should an asymptotically AdS holographic description interpret a rolling accelerating interior that requires an initial singularity?

sources.title: Holographic complexity in string and M theory

evidence.text: How should holographic complexity be formulated in full string/M-theory dualities, related to lower-dimensional AdS functionals, and constrained by higher-dimensional gauge invariance?

sources.title: Exploring the holographic Swampland

evidence.text: What structure does holography reveal in fibred LVS and DGKT moduli stabilisation, and does the previously proposed negativity of mixed double-trace anomalous dimensions survive these examples?

sources.title: A Covariant holographic entanglement entropy proposal

evidence.text: Can all subsystem entropies of one holographic state determine its classical bulk geometry? The proposed advantage over null-endpoint data is sensitivity to the metric's conformal factor and access to deeper bulk regions.

sources.title: A Holographic Derivation of the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can holographic entanglement and quantum-information theorems identify an inconsistency in WGC-violating Einsteinian AdS theories with exactly stable extremal black branes?

sources.title: A Spin‐2 Conjecture on the Swampland

evidence.text: Do the cited holographic AdS massive-spin-2 constructions and their proposed string embeddings satisfy Λm∼mMp/Mw?

sources.title: Holographic Complexity Equals Bulk Action?

evidence.text: Is holographic-state computational complexity dual to the action of a Wheeler–DeWitt patch, and do black-hole action-growth calculations support a universal maximal rate of computation?

sources.title: The dS / CFT correspondence

evidence.text: Can asymptotic symmetries and scalar boundary correlators support a holographic description of de Sitter quantum gravity by a Euclidean CFT, determine its central charge in three dimensions, and explain how bulk time and the two asymptotic boundaries are encoded?

sources.title: Weak Gravity Conjecture, Central Charges and $\eta/s$

evidence.text: Does an assumed AdS weak gravity conjecture constrain higher-derivative couplings sufficiently to enforce the KSS bound at extremality, and how do these constraints interact with holographic central-charge bounds?

sources.title: Bootstrap bound on extremal Reissner-Nordström black hole in AdS

evidence.text: Can the classical extremal Reissner–Nordström–AdS spectrum remain the lowest charged spectrum of a holographic quantum theory, especially for arbitrarily small black holes, while satisfying conformal-bootstrap constraints?

sources.title: Constraining braneworlds with entanglement entropy

evidence.text: Can entropy positivity and causal wedge inclusion constrain brane-localized gravitational couplings, and thereby assess proposed islands and nontrivial Page curves in two-brane models containing massless gravity?

sources.title: No Forbidden Landscape in String/M-theory

evidence.text: Does holographic consistency exclude string/M-theory backgrounds dual to scale-invariant but nonconformal field theories, and can this exclusion constrain compactifications and higher-derivative effective actions?

sources.title: Emergent Spacetime and Holographic CFTs

evidence.text: Which CFTs admit useful weakly coupled holographic descriptions, and why would factorization and CFT consistency naturally lead an observer to introduce AdS fields and Witten diagrams?

sources.title: Revisiting recent progress in the Karch–Randall braneworld

evidence.text: Can a diffeomorphism-invariant radiation region support an entanglement island in massless wedge gravity, can DGP terms change the answer, and what do holographic consistency and the precise intermediate description imply for brane couplings and causality?

sources.title: Holographic Constraint on Scale Separation

evidence.text: Does large-N holography constrain cubic scalar interactions when operator dimensions form extremal or super-extremal arrangements, and do the simplest scale-separated DGKT AdS₄ vacua satisfy that constraint?

sources.title: Holography and wormholes in 2+1 dimensions

evidence.text: How does real-time holography encode topology hidden behind horizons when every outer region is a static BTZ exterior? The apparent mismatch is between m exterior mass parameters and 6g−6+3m surface moduli in the general construction.

sources.title: Complexity is simple!

evidence.text: Under what circuit assumptions can Lloyd's computational bound constrain holographic complexity, and can violations inferred from complexity = action support an argument for the Weak Gravity Conjecture?

sources.title: Holographic partition functions and phases for higher genus Riemann surfaces

evidence.text: How can classical bulk actions and dominant-saddle phase diagrams be computed for holographic CFT partition functions on higher-genus Riemann surfaces, including competition between handlebodies, selected non-handlebodies, and symmetry-breaking saddles?

sources.title: Entanglement entropy in three dimensional gravity

evidence.text: How can regulated geodesic lengths and holographic interval entropies be computed efficiently in topologically complicated pure three-dimensional gravity, and under what conditions can Euclidean calculations justify covariant HRT?

sources.title: Putting the Boot into the Swampland

evidence.text: Can universal holographic data of moduli-stabilised AdS4 vacua, especially LVS, make their quantum-gravity consistency accessible through unitarity and crossing constraints on putative three-dimensional CFT duals?

sources.title: Discrete scale invariance in holography revisited

evidence.text: Does the proposed six-dimensional bottom-up holographic model genuinely reduce continuous conformal symmetry to Poincaré symmetry plus discrete scale invariance, or does its exact solution retain hidden continuous isometries? Can a more general warped ansatz separate scale from conformal invariance?

sources.title: A handbook of holographic 4-point functions

evidence.text: How can tree-level scalar holographic four-point functions be evaluated explicitly in momentum space, renormalized diagram by diagram, and related through changes of regularization scheme and weight-shifting operators?

sources.title: Conformal field theories dual to quantum gravity with strongly coupled matter

evidence.text: Can holographic CFTs retain weak gravitational interactions while selected matter operators fail large-N factorization, thereby allowing matter interactions at the AdS scale rather than only Planck-suppressed interactions?

sources.title: The Holographic bound in anti-de Sitter space

evidence.text: How does AdS/CFT implement the holographic information bound, beyond identifying a gravitational bulk theory with a boundary theory, when both boundary area and boundary entropy are initially infinite?

sources.title: End of the world brane meets $ T\overline{T} $

evidence.text: How can an EOW brane and a finite Dirichlet cutoff coexist in AdS gravity, and does partial reduction produce a gravitational system with a nonconformal T T̄ bath whose entropies and Page curves agree between island and holographic prescriptions?

How does homogeneous Yang–Baxter deformation affect wedge holography, Karch–Randall brane tensions, island/Page-curve calculations and late-time holographic complexity?

How can tension-dependent BCFT2 thermodynamics be combined with the effective JT thermodynamics seen by EOW-brane observers, and what do these observers see when temperature is lowered and the branes meet?
How does brane-localized JT gravity alter volume-complexity growth in planar BTZ, which couplings respect the Lloyd bound, and can bulk energy conditions explain violations?

Can wedge holography be constructed with a de Sitter bulk and de Sitter gravitating branes, and can suitable arrangements and gluing of those branes model universes or multiverses capable of exchanging information?

What controlled subleading holographic information follows from higher-derivative supergravity, and do holographic c-function monotonicity and consistent truncations survive four-derivative corrections?

What holographic spectra and anomalous-dimension signs arise from fibred LVS and M-theory moduli stabilization, and how do charged-black-hole Wheeler–DeWitt states connect interiors, boundary partition functions and horizon thermodynamics?

How does semiclassical AdS3 holography extend to compact Riemann-surface boundaries of arbitrary genus, and what do the resulting gravitational actions imply for boundary stress tensors, black-hole topology and thermodynamics?

Which bulk region can be holographically encoded on an AdS4 brane with localized gravity, despite the infinite AdS5 volume, and how does a bulk particle's brane image disappear when it leaves that region?

Can a five-dimensional constant curvature black hole support a holographic stress-tensor calculation on its time-dependent boundary, and how does this geometry relate to Schwarzschild–AdS bubbles of nothing?
Can Euclidean AdS geometries connect disconnected boundaries supporting well-defined field theories, and how should their correlations and continued closed cosmologies be interpreted holographically?

sources.title: Euclidean wormholes in string theory

evidence.text: Can the axion and dilaton fields of a string compactification support a smooth Euclidean throat? The relevant classical equations use an indefinite scalar metric obtained by continuing the axionic variables while retaining ordinary dilaton kinetic signs.

sources.title: There is no R**3 x S**1 vacuum gravitational instanton

evidence.text: Can a nonflat vacuum gravitational instanton exist on R^3 × S^1 with asymptotically flat noncompact directions and a fixed Euclidean period only near infinity?

sources.title: Instantons and wormholes in Minkowski and (A)dS spaces

evidence.text: When do Euclidean instantons and nonsingular, finite-action wormholes exist in d-dimensional axion-dilaton gravity with zero, negative or positive cosmological constant, and how does existence depend on the dilaton coupling?

sources.title: Non-extremal instantons and wormholes in string theory

evidence.text: Which non-extremal, spherically symmetric Euclidean gravity–dilaton–axion solutions exist, when are they completely regular wormholes, and can such wormholes occur in Calabi–Yau compactifications of string theory?

sources.title: Euclidean wormholes in string theory

evidence.text: Fourier project onto charges before extremizing, vary endpoint values as integration variables, solve the resulting complex equations, and retain all boundary terms in the weight. For wormholes, only dilatons must interpolate continuously between the specified physical end data.

sources.title: There is no R**3 x S**1 vacuum gravitational instanton

evidence.text: Seek harmonic fields approaching the compact and Cartesian coordinates, then integrate a divergence identity containing the squared Hessian and Ric(∇φ, ∇φ). Boundary fluxes at infinity relate these nonnegative quantities to the asymptotic mass parameter.

sources.title: Instantons and wormholes in Minkowski and (A)dS spaces

evidence.text: Dualize the Lorentzian axion to a (d−1)-form field strength, continue to Euclidean signature, and dualize back. The paper emphasizes that continuation and dualization do not commute; boundary terms are needed for the variational principle and action.

sources.title: Non-extremal instantons and wormholes in string theory

evidence.text: Use axion/form duality to determine the Euclidean continuation and the additional surface term defining the instanton action. The universal hypermultiplet continuation is motivated through its double-tensor formulation.

sources.title: Euclidean wormholes in string theory

evidence.text: Vary the spherical lapse before fixing N = 1, reparametrize the scalar evolution, and solve target-space geodesic motion together with the radial constraint. A throat in the radial solution is insufficient unless the scalar trajectory remains regular.

sources.title: There is no R**3 x S**1 vacuum gravitational instanton

evidence.text: Impose the paper's 'Lorentz' gauge on the trace-reversed metric perturbation and Fourier-expand along the compact coordinate. Each mode satisfies (Δ_3 − n^2ω^2)φ_n = 0; the gauge condition eliminates leading 1/r coefficients except C_00.

sources.title: Instantons, Euclidean wormholes and AdS/CFT

evidence.text: How should axion-induced Euclidean wormholes, extremal instantons and singular under-extremal saddles be interpreted in quantum gravity and AdS/CFT, and which can contribute to the path integral?

sources.title: Wormholes made without massless matter fields

evidence.text: Can Euclidean wormholes exist without massless matter fields, and how do their charge, throat size, and effective operator insertions behave in a theory containing only a massive charged scalar and gravity?

sources.title: Non-extremal D-instantons and the AdS/CFT correspondence

evidence.text: Construct non-extremal D-instantons asymptotic to AdS5 × S5, determine their holographic axion/dilaton one-point functions and possible Yang–Mills interpretation, and investigate whether their Euclidean wormholes yield closed Lorentzian cosmologies.

sources.title: Axion Wormholes in AdS Compactifications

evidence.text: Can exact, regular axionic Euclidean wormholes be embedded in an AdS string compactification whose scalar Wick rotation is fixed by AdS/CFT, and what would their existence imply for their admissibility in the gravitational path integral?

sources.title: Axion-de Sitter wormholes

evidence.text: What regular Euclidean axion wormholes exist with positive cosmological constant, how stable and semiclassically weighted are they, and can their Lorentzian continuations describe quantum bridges between expanding de Sitter-like universes?

sources.title: A 10d construction of Euclidean axion wormholes in flat and AdS space

evidence.text: Can regular axion-supported Euclidean wormholes be explicitly lifted to ten dimensions with parametrically small curvature and coupling despite Planck-scale scalar excursions, and what holographic positivity puzzle remains for explicit AdS examples?

sources.title: A comment on no-force conditions for black holes and branes

evidence.text: How does timelike reduction explain no-force conditions for black holes and branes whose surface gravity or horizon area vanishes, and what heuristic lesson does the same formalism offer for axion instantons and Euclidean wormholes?

sources.title: Euclidean wormholes in string theory

evidence.text: The AdS3 × S3 × T4 background supplies a known holographic laboratory in which a small, regular string wormhole could be tested against the properties of an ordinary finite-charge quantum system.

sources.title: Supersymmetric Wormholes in String Theory

evidence.text: Can regular supersymmetric Euclidean wormholes admitting a string-theory embedding be constructed and classified within an AdS5 supergravity truncation, and what boundary data and on-shell action determine their possible gravitational path-integral role?

sources.title: The axion quality problem: global symmetry breaking and wormholes

evidence.text: How strongly do Euclidean gravitational wormholes break continuous global symmetries, and do their actions preserve Peccei–Quinn axion quality? The paper also asks how an extended global symmetry and an open-string axion–dilaton system change the answer when radial modes are dynamical.

sources.title: Wormholes and the imaginary distance bound

evidence.text: Does the appearance of wormholes supported by imaginary scalar fields bound analytic continuation of a single gravitational theory's couplings, and do intrinsic string-theory effects invalidate its low-energy description at or before that bound?

sources.title: Wormholes in Maximal Supergravity

evidence.text: Do complex Euclidean wormholes exist in compactified supergravity, and can string theory include their saddle-point contributions? The paper distinguishes the classical existence problem from the compatibility of a complex integration contour with discrete gauge symmetry.

sources.title: Euclidean wormholes, baby universes, and their impact on particle physics and cosmology

evidence.text: Do Euclidean wormholes contribute to physical quantum gravity, and can their effects coexist with local effective field theory? The review treats censorship, baby-universe states, and the interpretation of coupling constants as unresolved questions even for large, low-curvature configurations.

sources.title: Axion wormholes with massive dilaton

evidence.text: How does stabilizing the dilaton change Euclidean axion instantons, wormhole necks, dilaton excursions and action-to-charge ratios, and do these corrections support the proposed axionic weak gravity conjecture?

sources.title: Axionic wormholes with <math display="inline"><msup><mi>R</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></math> correction in metric and Palatini formulations

evidence.text: How does an R² correction change axionic wormhole solutions, their actions and the estimated explicit Peccei-Quinn violation, and how do these effects depend on choosing metric or Palatini gravity?

sources.title: Instantons and no wormholes in $AdS_3\times S^3 \times CY_2$

evidence.text: Classify O(3)-symmetric Euclidean instantons sourced by AdS axion-saxion moduli, determine whether regular wormholes exist, and identify the brane interpretation of extremal solutions.

sources.title: Instantons and Wormholes for the Universal Hypermultiplet

evidence.text: How can fixed-axionic-charge transition amplitudes determine Euclidean continuation for noncommuting shifts, and yield universal-hypermultiplet instantons and wormholes with explicit supersymmetry and regularity conditions?
